entries.title: Proverbs 6:1
segments: ¶My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, [if] thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,

entries.title: Proverbs 6:2
segments: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:3
segments: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend. {and make...: or, so shalt thou prevail with thy friend}

words.text: . {and make...: or, so shalt thou prevail with thy friend}

entries.title: Proverbs 6:4
segments: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:5
segments: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand [of the hunter], and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.

words.text: [of the hunter], and as a bird

entries.title: Proverbs 6:6
segments: ¶Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:

entries.title: Proverbs 6:7
segments: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,

entries.title: Proverbs 6:8
segments: Provideth her meat in the summer, [and] gathereth her food in the harvest.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:9
segments: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?

entries.title: Proverbs 6:10
segments: [Yet] a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:

entries.title: Proverbs 6:11
segments: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:12
segments: ¶A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:13
segments: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;

entries.title: Proverbs 6:14
segments: Frowardness [is] in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord. {soweth: Heb. casteth forth}

entries.title: Proverbs 6:15
segments: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:16
segments: These six [things] doth the LORD hate: yea, seven [are] an abomination unto him: {unto...: Heb. of his soul}

entries.title: Proverbs 6:17
segments: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood, {A proud...: Heb. Haughty eyes}

entries.title: Proverbs 6:18
segments: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,

entries.title: Proverbs 6:19
segments: A false witness [that] speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:20
segments: ¶My son, keep thy father's commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:

entries.title: Proverbs 6:21
segments: Bind them continually upon thine heart, [and] tie them about thy neck.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:22
segments: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and [when] thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:23
segments: For the commandment [is] a lamp; and the law [is] light; and reproofs of instruction [are] the way of life: {lamp: or, candle}

entries.title: Proverbs 6:24
segments: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman. {of the...: or, of the strange tongue}

words.text: . {of the...: or, of the strange tongue}

entries.title: Proverbs 6:25
segments: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:26
segments: For by means of a whorish woman [a man is brought] to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life. {the adulteress: Heb. the woman of a man, or, a man's wife}

words.text: [a man is brought] to a piece
. {the adulteress: Heb. the woman of a man, or, a man's wife}

entries.title: Proverbs 6:27
segments: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?

entries.title: Proverbs 6:28
segments: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?

entries.title: Proverbs 6:29
segments: So he that goeth in to his neighbour's wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:30
segments: [Men] do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;

entries.title: Proverbs 6:31
segments: But [if] he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:32
segments: [But] whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he [that] doeth it destroyeth his own soul. {understanding: Heb. heart}

entries.title: Proverbs 6:33
segments: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:34
segments: For jealousy [is] the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:35
segments: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts. {He will...: Heb. He will not accept the face of any ransom}

words.text: . {He will...: Heb. He will not accept the face of any ransom}
